text: An internal ccw MCP tool, exactly one (`command`, input {name: enum of the session's agent allowlist, params?}), lets the main agent self-compact, self-reload plugins and run the other allowlisted slash commands it cannot call directly; subagent and teammate calls are refused; the token is never stored in a file.

Same-turn lifecycle: a command queued during a turn runs at the turn's Stop at an idle prompt and the agent resumes in the same turn; idle sessions run it at once; events, onCommand (veto) and onCommandComplete hooks, PreCompact and PostCompact relays, and command and compaction metrics.
Public endpoint POST /v1/sessions/{id}/commands plus GET of one command and the list, on the same queue and lifecycle (redundancy with the turns endpoint accepted).
Optional auto-compact after a configured inactivity time (sessions.auto_compact), once per idle gap, never extending the idle reaper.
Transcript parser fix, always on: compact summaries, meta entries and command echoes are not prompts, so old turn markers cannot make Stops look stale.
Docs and examples: README Slash commands section, config.example.yaml and workbench example snippets, auto_compact blocks in the tatara and magic-trainer examples.
